en.title: Minister Bolat's 'Made in EU' diplomacy: We want regulation on a win-win basis
en.summary: Turkey's Trade Minister discussed the potential effects of the EU's Industrial Acceleration Act's "Made in EU" approach with senior EU officials, stating both sides are conducting intensive negotiations for mutually beneficial arrangements. A high-level Turkey-EU trade dialogue is scheduled for October 13 in Brussels.

stories.title: ABD, Çin ile yapılan anlaşmanın detaylarını açıkladı: 30'ar milyar dolarlık ürün karşılıklı kapsama alındı

en.title: US discloses details of agreement with China: 30 billion dollars worth of products each covered
en.summary: The United States and China agreed on a "30 by 30" trade framework allowing approximately 30 billion dollars of non-sensitive goods from each country to benefit from more favorable tariff rates. Agricultural products and medical devices feature prominently in US exports, while small appliances and consumer goods characterize Chinese exports.

en.summary: Three individuals, including a former MASAK deputy department head, were arrested in connection with an investigation into political or military espionage targeting MASAK's integrated financial intelligence system. A fourth person was released under judicial supervision.
